name: Israel, Gaza & region
value: Gaza strikes 24 Nov; Yemen strikes 23–24 Nov
summary: Israeli strikes kill seven in Gaza on 24 Nov; Houthi media report deadly Saudi strikes in Yemen on 23 and 24 Nov
state: Israeli airstrikes killed at least seven people in Gaza on 24 Nov, including the head of Hamas's internal security apparatus in Gaza City, medics and the Hamas-run interior ministry said (Reuters via RTÉ). Houthi media said a Saudi strike in Hodeida killed 17 people on 23 Nov and one in Lahj left 25 dead or missing on 24 Nov (CBS News). Israeli strikes hit three districts of southern Lebanon on 21 Nov as President Aoun demanded a full Israeli withdrawal (Al Jazeera). Hostilities on several fronts keep the Alert.
for_you: Follow FCDO travel advice for Israel, the Palestinian territories, Lebanon, Yemen and Saudi Arabia, which advises against travel to several areas. Regional flights and Red Sea shipping can be disrupted at short notice.
rubric_hit: Alert: multi-front hostilities; Israeli strikes in Gaza 24 Nov and Lebanon 21 Nov, Saudi strikes in Yemen 23–24 Nov

why: Conflict involving Israel, Gaza, Lebanon, Syria and Yemen threatens civilians, shipping and wider escalation. Direct hostilities with Iran are tracked under Gulf / US–Iran war.

rubric.alert: Multi-front escalation, major cross-border strikes between Israel and its neighbours, or mass-casualty events.
rubric.watch: Ongoing hostilities on one front, or a ceasefire repeatedly violated.
rubric.normal: Ceasefires holding across fronts (Gaza, Lebanon, Syria, Yemen).
